desc: Implement the primary solution: read input, compress values, compute diagonal_sum, compute H_t via residue counts/sums for moduli 2^t, derive ordered_sum = H0 - sum_H, and output (ordered_sum + diagonal_sum) // 2.
Validate the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases such as N=1, all odd/even values, and large values near 10^7.
Optimize residue aggregation with hybrid dense arrays for small moduli and dictionaries for large moduli.
Keep fallback approaches (exact-valuation variant, LSB trie, parity divide-and-conquer) only if the primary residue-grouping approach fails or is too slow.
